resonance.speculativeBannerDetail: The Dykeman & Sankey (2010) acoustic resonance model was validated on rigid non-enveloped protein capsids (CCMV, TMV). For cells with SPECULATIVE basis, f_res and Q are theoretical estimates without direct spectroscopic measurement. GHz EM fields also face penetration limits in aqueous media (Debye relaxation above 1 GHz). Treat these as starting estimates for protocol design.
resonance.chartNote: Disruption ratio = (E / E_thr) × L(f, f_res, Q)
resonance.noteBody: Acoustic/mechanical capsid & cell-wall disruption. f_res ≈ v_protein/(2R): rigid icosahedral viral capsids ~15-40 GHz (Dykeman & Sankey 2010 atomistic; CCMV lowest H mode ≈ 21 GHz); enveloped viruses lower (~4-8 GHz, Thakur 2015 H3N2; Sci. Rep. 2022 SARS-CoV-2); bacterial walls ~0.5-1.5 GHz. Mammalian cells (R ≈ 10 µm) have no GHz resonance, hence frequency-selective disruption. Ref: Dykeman & Sankey (2010); Murray & Saviot (2007); Thakur et al. (2015)
resonance.noResonance: No resonance parameters for this cell
resonance.tipFieldFormula: Disruption ratio = (E / E_threshold) × L(f, f_res, Q)
resonance.tipTargetBadgeNote: ≥100% at resonance → capsid/cell-wall disruption threshold exceeded
resonance.tipHealthyBadgeBody:
Mammalian cells lack rigid-shell resonance, Schwan Vm → 0 at GHz (ωτ ≫ 1).
At f_res(target) in GHz, healthy cell disruption ≈ 0.
